assets.assignedOperativeText:
There must be a continuous path
of Reinforced Corridors
from the Landing Zone (Section A)
to the Life Support Control C.

AND

The Facility must NOT be destroyed.

officialCounterpart.title: THE SUPPLY ROUTE
officialCounterpart.body:
There must be a continuous path of Reinforced Corridors from the Landing Zone (Section A) to the Life Support Control C.
AND
The Facility must NOT be destroyed.

assets.assignedOperativeText:
At least 1 [character] with a Data token
(from the Server Room in Section B)
must Escape using the [lander] (Section A).

AND

There must be no Unexplored
Corridors in Section A.

officialCounterpart.title: ESSENTIAL DATA
officialCounterpart.body:
At least 1 [character] with a Data token (from the Server Room in Section B) must Escape using the [lander] (Section A).
AND
There must be no Unexplored Corridors in Section A.

assets.assignedOperativeText:
At least 2 Eggs must
be taken out of the Facility using
the Lander or Escape Shuttle.

officialCounterpart.title: PRIMARY SAMPLES
officialCounterpart.body: All [character] who Escape from the Facility must be carrying at least 2 Eggs in total among them (no matter if they Survive after Escaping).

conflicts: Assigned art requires at least 2 Eggs to be taken out using the Lander or Escape Shuttle; current official text instead requires all escaping Characters collectively to carry at least 2 Eggs.
Assigned art omits the current official survival-after-Escaping qualifier.

assets.assignedOperativeText:
The Reactor must be shut down.

AND

All Section Rooms A must be Explored.

officialCounterpart.title: PERIMETER CLEARING
officialCounterpart.body:
The Reactor (Section C) must be shut down (by using the Room).
AND
All 3 Rooms of the A type must be Discovered.

conflicts: Assigned applicability is ALL; current official applicability is 2+.
Assigned Reactor condition omits Section C and the by-using-the-Room method qualifier.
Assigned text says all Section Rooms A must be Explored; current official text says all 3 Rooms of the A type must be Discovered.

Server Room must be Reinforced. (There is
a continuous path of Reinforced Corridors
from the Landing zone to the Server Room).

AND

The Facility must not be destroyed.
